draft.en: Rendering contract: keep a clean white or near-white canvas, clear reading order, short labels, crisp arrows, and enough spacing that no module or label touches another element. Avoid micro-text, decorative effects, blurred edges, fake fine print, and cropped content. Keep all essential labels readable at normal viewing size.
draft.zh: 渲染约束：使用白色或近白色画布，保持清晰阅读顺序、简短标签、清楚箭头和足够留白。任何模块或标签都不得互相挤压。避免微小文字、装饰性效果、模糊边缘、伪造小字和内容裁切，核心标签在正常查看尺寸下必须清楚可读。

paper.en: Publication rendering contract: produce a clean academic vector-like figure on a white or near-white background. Use one explicit reading direction and keep a safe outer margin around the entire composition. Keep all important modules fully inside the canvas with no clipping. Use large, clean text regions; concise labels; strong text/background contrast; consistent sans-serif-like typography; and a simple hierarchy in which titles/panel labels are strongest, primary module labels are medium, and secondary notes are smallest. Do not use unreadable micro-text. The complete figure must remain understandable and the essential labels must remain readable when the image is viewed at roughly 50% of its native size or placed at single-column paper width. Prefer fewer larger labels over many tiny annotations. Use crisp, uniform arrows and borders with unambiguous arrowheads; prevent arrows from crossing text or disappearing into fills. Keep repeated modules aligned, use disciplined spacing, and avoid accidental overlaps. Use a restrained low-to-medium-saturation scientific palette with consistent semantic meaning and sufficient contrast; avoid glossy 3D rendering, cinematic lighting, noisy textures, poster gradients, and raster-looking blur unless explicitly requested. Preserve source-faithful scientific relationships and never invent fine-print labels, formulas, values, or decorative pseudo-technical detail. The result should look clean enough for a paper figure and stable enough for later image editing.
paper.zh: 论文渲染约束：生成白色或近白色背景的学术矢量感科研图。只采用一种明确的主阅读方向，并在画布四周保留安全边距；所有关键模块必须完整位于画布内，不得裁切。使用大而干净的文字区域、简洁标签、明显的文字与背景对比、统一的无衬线字体风格，并建立简单清楚的字号层级：标题或面板标记最突出，核心模块标签次之，辅助说明最小。禁止难以辨认的微小文字。整张图在约 50% 原始尺寸查看或缩放到论文单栏宽度时，核心标签仍应清楚可读、结构仍应容易理解；宁可减少标签数量并放大，也不要塞入大量小字。箭头和边框必须清晰、线宽一致、箭头端点明确，箭头不得穿过文字或与填充色融为一体。重复模块应严格对齐，间距稳定，不允许意外重叠。采用低到中等饱和度的科研配色，并保持颜色语义一致和足够对比；除非用户明确要求，不使用强 3D、电影光影、噪声纹理、海报渐变或模糊栅格效果。必须忠实保留科学关系，不得虚构小字、公式、数值或装饰性的伪技术细节。最终效果应达到论文插图的清洁度，并适合后续继续修改。

final.en: Final-export rendering contract: satisfy every publication constraint from the paper profile and make clarity the highest visual priority. Use the full native canvas efficiently without crowding it; maintain safe outer margins and generous internal spacing. Essential labels must remain readable at approximately 50% native scale and must not rely on tiny footnotes. Use crisp high-contrast text regions, sharp module boundaries, uniform line weights, clean arrowheads, and no visible blur, ghosting, compression-like artifacts, clipped labels, or cut-off modules. Keep the composition visually balanced at the requested aspect ratio and do not redesign unrelated scientific content merely to fill space. Favor lossless-looking flat/vector-like rendering and restrained colors. If the requested canvas or provider cannot realistically satisfy an explicit pixel-size or final-export requirement, do not pretend that a smaller image is equivalent; report the limitation instead of silently downgrading.
final.zh: 最终导出渲染约束：在满足 paper 级全部论文约束的基础上，将清晰度作为最高视觉优先级。充分利用原生画布，但不得为了塞满画面而拥挤；保持安全外边距和充足内部间距。核心标签在约 50% 原始尺寸下仍必须可读，不能依赖微小脚注。文字区域要高对比且清晰，模块边界锐利，线宽统一，箭头端点干净；不得出现明显模糊、重影、类似压缩的伪影、标签裁切或模块被截断。构图必须适配所要求的画布比例并保持平衡，不得为了填充空间而无关地重设计科学内容。优先采用无损感、平面化、矢量感的表现和克制配色。如果当前 provider 或画布无法真实满足用户明确提出的像素尺寸或最终导出要求，不得把更小图片假装成等价高清结果，应明确报告限制而不是静默降级。
